description: Show one or more posts to the user as interactive cards: the picture, swipeable carousel or video, the full text (editable), the publish time (changeable), the connected channels (tickable) and buttons to approve, schedule or publish. Use this whenever you present a post or a post suggestion to the user — after generate_posts has finished, or when they ask to see, review or approve posts — instead of pasting the caption and a link. Pass several ids to let them page through the suggestions. In a client that cannot draw cards the result is a short text summary; use get_post for the details then.

postIds.description: The posts to show, in the order to show them
